desc: Implement helper `sum_extreme(nums, k, is_max)`: monotonic stack giving previous strictly-greater (or strictly-smaller) and next greater-or-equal (or smaller-or-equal) distances per index.
Implement O(1) count function: given left, right, k, count pairs (x, y) with 0 ≤ x < left, 0 ≤ y < right, x + y ≤ k - 1 via split at x0 = k - right and triangular-number formulas.
Combine: answer = sum_extreme(is_max=True) + sum_extreme(is_max=False); wire into `minMaxSubarraySum` starter code.
Validate on both examples (expect 20 and -6) plus edge cases: k = 1 (answer = 2*sum(nums)), k = n, duplicates, all-negative arrays.
Brute-force cross-check on small random arrays to confirm counting formula and tie-breaking correctness; confirm O(n) for n = 80000.
